notes.observations: HDR views: the CTL limits to Rec.2020 in D60-adapted XYZ before the D60->D65 CAT (limit_to_primaries then CAT), so channels are not monotonic near the peak (R 9.764766 -> 9.764666 at 295 for 1000 nits), a saturated neutral lands near 97.7 % of the peak and a channel may pass the peak (10.0227 for ACEScg (-1e30,5,0.3)); OCIO's HDR built-ins have the same structure (ADAPTATION_NONE clamp then Bradford) and match to 7.7e-7
